system.name: Ouroboros
system.one_liner: a wafer-scale SRAM computing-in-memory architecture that performs all LLM inference operations in situ within first-level SRAM using token-grained pipelining

content.subject: how Ouroboros remaps tasks and evicts a KV cache along a replacement chain from a failed core to nearest KV core

content.key_idea: When a core fails, Ouroboros forms a replacement chain to the nearest KV-storing core: each core's weights shift one hop toward the fault, evicting that KV cache, covering the failure without full remapping optimization.
content.reading_order: Left to right: the abstract task graph, then the healthy Initial Mapping grid, then the Remapping with Fault grid; compare matching grid positions to see which tasks shifted.

summary: Figure 9 illustrates Ouroboros's fault-tolerance scheme for its wafer-scale SRAM computing-in-memory grid. On the left, a small task graph shows the dependency structure among six pipeline tasks, T1 through T6. The middle panel, Initial Mapping, places these tasks plus two dedicated KV-cache cores onto a 2x4 grid of cores connected by a bidirectional mesh network. The right panel, Remapping with Fault, shows the same grid after the core holding T6 fails (marked with a red X): the recovery mechanism forms a replacement chain from the faulty core to the nearest KV-storing core, so T6's weights move into the neighboring core that held T4, and T4's weights move into the core beyond it that held a KV cache, evicting that cache. This local, chain-based remapping completes in sub-millisecond time without invoking the system's full mixed-integer placement optimizer.
summary_zh: 图9展示Ouroboros的故障容错重映射：左侧任务图给出T1-T6依赖关系；中间初始映射把任务和KV核放入2x4网格；右侧核心故障(红叉)后，沿故障核到最近KV核形成替换链，逐核前移权重并驱逐KV缓存，亚毫秒级完成恢复。
notes: Kept primary group 'evolution' from prior labels; content.panels holds only the two grid-mapping frames (Initial Mapping / Remapping with Fault), which are the actual before/after pair, while the leftmost Task Graph sub-diagram is treated as supporting context (it supplies the T1-T6 dependency edges used in 'relations') rather than a third evolution frame. layout.panel_count=3 reflects all three drawn sub-diagrams; layout.panels=1 is kept as given by the index, which appears to undercount.
